note: Kuwani waa tixraacyo cilmiyeed oo la jaanqaadaya aŭ sii baaraya qaabka Gaarriye. Ma aha xeerar Gaarriye, mana beddelaan asalka.

sources.author: Martin Orwin
sources.title: On Consonants in Somali Metrics
sources.relationship: Cilmi-baadhistu waxay ka shidaal qaadataa maqaal Gaarriye, waxayna si qoto dheer u baartaa boosaska shibbanayaasha ee miisaanka, gaar ahaan Jiifto.
sources.allowed_use: Fasiraad iyo dib-u-eegis ku saabsan boosaska shibbanayaasha; lama beddeli karo xeerarka Gaarriye asalkooda.
sources.evidence_note: Afrah (2013), pp.155-158, wuxuu sheegayaa in Orwin (2001) dib u baaray fikradihii Gaarriye ee boosaska miisaanka Jiiftada, isagoo sii faahfaahiyey kaalinta shibbanayaasha dhammaadka alanka.

sources.author: Mohamed Dahir Yusuf Afrah
sources.title: Between Continuity and Innovation: Transitional Nature of Post-independence Somali Poetry and Drama 1960s – the Present
sources.publication: PhD thesis, SOAS University of London, Chapter 4.2, pp.154-158
sources.relationship: Afrah wuxuu diiwaangeliyey in Gaarriye (1976) soo bandhigay xeerarka aasaasiga ah ee Gabay, Jiifto, Baar-cadde iyo Heesta Kabadaha; wuxuu sheegay in Orwin (2001) si qoto dheer u baaray boosaska shibbanayaasha ee Jiifto. Waxa kale oo uu caddeeyey in cilmi-baadhistu horumar samaysay balse faahfaahinta qaar weli u baahan tahay daraasad.
sources.allowed_use: Xaqiijinta taariikhda cilmi-baadhista iyo in la kala saaro waxyaabaha la isku raacsan yahay iyo faahfaahinta weli furan; ma aha xeer cusub oo engine lagu daro.
